title: An extension principle for Einstein-Maxwell-charged scalar field system with finite Doppler exponent
summary: We prove a new extension principle for the spherically symmetric Einstein--Maxwell--charged scalar field system. Rather than imposing conditions for mass ratio $2m/r$ as in Christodoulou's small-mass-ratio criterion or as in An--Chen--Singh's proof [1] with $2m/r<3/8$, here we work through a proposal by An-Tan [2] with finite Doppler exponent (blueshift). By conducting two successive blow-up analyses, followed by a stationary comparison and a rigidity argument, we establish the uniform boundness of $α'$ with $α'=\partial_vα/\partial_vr$ and $α=\partial_v(rφ)/\partial_vr$.
